title: I Feel Like I'm in a Movie
description: I Feel Like I’m in a Movie explores the boundary between personal memory, emotional projection, and cinematic atmosphere. The series approaches everyday moments of intimacy, quiet solitude, and vulnerability as if they were frozen frames from an unwritten film. Through expressive color palettes, layered textures, and fluid figurative forms, the artworks capture the heightened reality of lived experience - that specific sensation when life temporarily transforms into scenes of cinematic intensity. Grounded in contemporary love discourse, the collection examines nostalgia, narrative construction, and the soft, dreamlike spaces where personal emotion turns into shared mythology.
